title: Three animals
decides: Three separate ideas inside 15 s: one call or three calls?
setting: A wildlife film in natural light, rich colour, steady camera, shallow depth of field.

beats.text: A male lion lies on a sandstone rock at sunrise and lifts his head toward the light.
Two penguins dive from an icy ledge into clear blue water, seen at water level.
A giraffe stretches its neck and pulls leaves from the top of an acacia tree, seen from below.

checks: Lion, then penguins, then giraffe, in order
No two animals in one frame
